neighborhoodDescription: Harpers Point sits in the Sixteen Mile Stand area of Cincinnati, surrounded by dining, shopping, and entertainment. Three shopping centers are within a 7-minute walk, including Shops at Harper's Point. Regal Deerfield Town Center is nearby for movies. Five parks within 10 miles, and I-275 access puts downtown Cincinnati just 20 minutes away.

faqs.question: What floor plans does Harpers Point offer?
faqs.answer: Harpers Point offers 8 floor plans including one-bedroom apartments (696-826 sq ft), two-bedroom apartments and townhomes (848-1,405 sq ft), and three-bedroom townhomes (1,405-1,445 sq ft). Prices range from $1,285 to $2,601 per month (as of Q3 2026).

faqs.question: Are pets allowed at Harpers Point?
faqs.answer: Yes, Harpers Point is pet-friendly. A maximum of 2 pets per unit is allowed with a 50 lb weight limit. Breed restrictions apply. Pet rent is $35 per month per pet, with a $150 refundable fee and $150 nonrefundable fee.

faqs.question: Does Harpers Point have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes, Harpers Point features a resort-style swimming pool with a sundeck, plus a white sand beach area within the community. The community was designed around a resort-living concept.

faqs.question: What is the pub at Harpers Point?
faqs.answer: Harpers Point has a full-service pub on-site that is open 7 days a week. Residents can enjoy dining and drinks without leaving the community, a unique amenity not found at most apartment communities.

faqs.question: How far is Harpers Point from downtown Cincinnati?
faqs.answer: Harpers Point is approximately 20 minutes from downtown Cincinnati via I-275. The property is in the Sixteen Mile Stand area with three shopping centers within a 7-minute walk.

faqs.question: What apartment features are included?
faqs.answer: Every apartment includes central A/C, stainless-steel appliances, granite countertops, spacious walk-in closets, and washer/dryer hookups or in-unit laundry. Select units feature vaulted ceilings, wood-burning fireplaces, and private balconies or patios.

faqs.question: Are there townhomes available at Harpers Point?
faqs.answer: Yes, Harpers Point offers two-story townhomes alongside single-level apartments. Townhome options include 2-bedroom (1,405 sq ft) and 3-bedroom (1,405-1,445 sq ft) layouts with 1.5 to 2.5 bathrooms.

faqs.question: What recreational amenities are at Harpers Point?
faqs.answer: Recreational amenities include a resort-style swimming pool, white sand beach, state-of-the-art fitness center, tennis courts, basketball courts, and award-winning landscaping with scenic waterscapes throughout the grounds.

faqs.question: What shopping is near Harpers Point?
faqs.answer: Three shopping centers are within a 7-minute walk, including Shops at Harper's Point and Harpers Station, which offer a mix of retail, dining, and services. Regal Deerfield Town Center for movies is also nearby.

faqs.question: Does Harpers Point have waitlisted floor plans?
faqs.answer: Yes, The Coronado (2 bed/1.5 bath townhome, 1,405 sq ft) and The Delmar (3 bed/2.5 bath townhome, 1,445 sq ft) are currently on waitlist due to high demand. Contact the leasing office to join the waitlist.
